d: We are seeking a results-driven Assistant Mobilization Manager to join our operations team in Dubai. In this role, you will drive the end-to-end mobilization and onboarding of Owners Association (OA) and property management accounts, ensuring new communities and developments are transitioned smoothly into operational readiness. You will work closely with developers, clients, internal departments, contractors, and service providers to coordinate procurement, handover, vendor onboarding, documentation, and budget preparation. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects simultaneously while maintaining rigorous follow-through on every action item.
q: Around 3–5 years of relevant UAE experience, preferably within Owners Association (OA), Property Management (PM), Community Management, or related real-estate operations, with solid exposure to the Dubai market.

Good working knowledge of OA/PM operations, including procurement and tendering, vendor/service-provider coordination, budgeting, contracts, property handover/onboarding requirements, documentation, and general operational processes.
Understanding of the procurement cycle — preparing/collecting requirements, obtaining and comparing quotations, coordinating tenders, following approvals, vendor onboarding, and tracking delivery.

Strong ability to organize and drive multiple onboarding projects simultaneously, maintain trackers and action plans, establish priorities and deadlines, and ensure actions are closed rather than simply reported.
Able to understand dependencies — what needs to happen first, what can happen in parallel, what could delay operational readiness, and where early action is required.
Strong at coordinating across internal departments, developers/clients, contractors, and service providers, with persistent follow-up and clear escalation when deadlines or dependencies are at risk.
Strong written and verbal English; professional stakeholder communication, meeting coordination, minutes/action tracking, and concise reporting to management.
Able to identify gaps, chase missing information, propose practical alternatives, and keep onboarding progressing rather than waiting passively for everything to be provided.
Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills; comfortable working with trackers, reports, budgets, and project documentation.
Experience with property-management systems is an advantage.
RERA / Dubai real-estate regulatory knowledge or relevant certification.
Hands-on experience with community mobilization from developer handover to operational go-live.
Familiarity with OA budgeting and service-charge cycles.
Arabic language skills are a plus.
r: Plan, coordinate, and drive the mobilization and onboarding of new OA/PM accounts and communities, from award through to full operational readiness.
Manage property handover and onboarding requirements, including documentation collection, compliance checks, and developer/client coordination.
Develop and maintain detailed onboarding trackers, action plans, milestones, and deadlines; ensure actions are closed out rather than simply reported.
Identify dependencies and critical-path items — what must happen first, what can run in parallel, and where early action is required to avoid delays.
Support the full procurement cycle: gathering and consolidating requirements, obtaining and comparing quotations, coordinating tenders, following the approval workflow, and tracking delivery.
Coordinate vendor and service-provider onboarding, including contracts, insurance, and compliance documentation.
Liaise with contractors and service providers on scope, schedules, and performance during the mobilization phase.
Assist in preparing and reviewing mobilizing projects budgets, cost estimates, and contract documentation.
Maintain accurate, up-to-date project files, records, and operational documentation in line with company and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate across internal departments, developers/clients, contractors, and service providers to keep mobilization on track.
Conduct persistent follow-up on pending items and escalate clearly and promptly when deadlines or dependencies are at risk.
Organize and lead mobilization meetings, prepare agendas, record minutes, and track action items to closure.
Prepare concise, regular progress reports and updates for management.
Proactively identify gaps, chase missing information, propose practical alternatives, and keep onboarding progressing rather than waiting passively.

d: ABANA Enterprises Group Co. is looking for a Presales Engineer to manage the technical and commercial preparation of bids, from the initial client inquiry through to project award.

The role involves reviewing tender documents, engineering drawings, and technical specifications; developing suitable technical solutions; preparing quantity takeoffs and bills of quantities; coordinating with suppliers and subcontractors; and preparing comprehensive technical and commercial proposals in line with project requirements.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
Experience in ICT/ELV presales, estimation, or solution design.
Ability to read engineering drawings, perform quantity takeoffs, and prepare detailed BOQs independently.
Working knowledge of copper and fiber cabling, racks and pathways, and active network components such as switches, uplinks, and wireless access points.
Proficiency in Excel for estimating and costing, and ability to use AutoCAD or an equivalent tool to review drawings and extract quantities.
Strong written and verbal English skills, with the ability to prepare proposals and coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams
r: Review RFQs, RFPs, drawings, specifications, and BOQs to identify scope gaps, quantity discrepancies, and items requiring client clarification.
Develop ICT and ELV solutions covering structured cabling, fiber optic networks, switching, wireless, CCTV, access control, and fire alarm systems, depending on the project scope.
Interpret floor plans, riser diagrams, schematics, and route drawings to prepare quantity takeoffs, material lists, and equipment schedules.
Coordinate site surveys with the project team and use the findings to validate quantities, installation requirements, and site constraints.
Obtain and evaluate quotations from vendors and subcontractors. Verify technical compliance, scope coverage, lead times, warranties, and commercial terms.
Prepare detailed cost estimates for materials, labor, subcontracted works, testing, and commissioning. Develop pricing in line with approved margins.
Prepare technical and commercial proposals, compliance matrices, datasheets, and clear assumptions, exclusions, and qualifications.

Support Sales during client meetings, technical presentations, and bid clarifications. Coordinate with the project team before submission to validate delivery commitments and hand over the awarded scope, costing, and bid commitments.

d: We are looking for an experienced Senior SharePoint Developer to join our team for a onsite engagement. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in SharePoint development, SPFx, React, TypeScript, Power Automate, and Azure Logic Apps, with experience in the banking or financial services domain preferred.
q: Experience working within the banking or financial services sector
Experience addressing application security and penetration-testing findings
Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science / Computer Science Engineering
r: Develop custom SharePoint web parts, extensions, and user interfaces using SharePoint Framework (SPFx) .
Build responsive and accessible solutions using React and TypeScript .
Integrate SharePoint solutions with Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, and third-party services .
Design and implement automated workflows using Power Automate and Azure Logic Apps .
Integrate Logic Apps with SharePoint, Dynamics 365, and external systems.
Monitor and optimize workflows, including performance and error handling.
Work with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver technical solutions.
Follow security, governance, and change-management processes.
Apply security fixes and address vulnerabilities identified through penetration testing.
Review technical service requests and business/security-related changes.
Provide technical documentation and support to business users.
